about.title: About Us
about.description1: Blaue Meer LTDA. is a Chilean company composed of a multidisciplinary team with top-level expertise in maritime, navigation, scientific, and environmental fields, united through a professional approach we call 'Industrial Eco-Oceanography.' This applies oceanography and related sciences to solve economic and ecological challenges in maritime sectors (ports, industry, fishing, and defense) through innovative and sustainable technological and industrial processes.
about.description2: From ultra-high-resolution oceanographic studies and modeling for coastal and bay management, ecosystem and biogeochemical studies and modeling, stability and maneuvering consulting, and maritime services such as refloating, refloating stranded vessels, and ship and marine structure dismantling, to specialized underwater services provided by a team of former Chilean Navy tactical divers, Blaue Meer seeks to deliver practical, efficient, sustainable, and environmentally friendly solutions.
about.description3: Our scientific team comes from the prestigious University of Concepción and maintains strong ties with international scientific communities.
work.title: Ship Recycling: An Eco-Social Challenge
work.description: Ship dismantling ranks among the five most dangerous occupations according to the International Labour Organization (ILO). It therefore requires addressing several challenges properly to ensure a safe and efficient process.
work.security.title: Safety
work.security.description1: Ship dismantling can be dangerous due to complex equipment and systems, along with the possible presence of hazardous materials and waste.
work.security.description2: Appropriate safety measures are essential to protect workers and minimize accident risks, ensuring a safe and efficient process.
work.ocean.title: Environment
work.ocean.description1: Ship dismantling can have a negative environmental impact if not properly managed.
work.ocean.description2: All applicable environmental regulations and standards must be followed to minimize environmental impact and protect human health, including that of workers and nearby communities.
work.recycle.title: Recycling
work.recycle.description1: A major challenge in ship dismantling is recycling materials and components removed from a vessel.
work.recycle.description2: Appropriate, certified recycling methods with documented final disposal must be ensured. This maximizes recycled materials while minimizing environmental impact.
work.cost.title: Costs
work.cost.description1: Ship dismantling can be costly due to the complexity of the work and the need to comply with specific regulations and standards.
work.cost.description2: Proper process planning is essential to minimize costs and maximize efficiency, ensuring a sustainable process.
scrachall.description: As a company, we understand the importance of complying with all applicable national and international regulations and standards, while ensuring the safety of both workers and the environment throughout our operations.
scrachall.scrapping.title: Ex PAM Zuiderster 4 Dismantling
scrachall.scrapping.description: Work successfully carried out between September 2014 and February 2015. Completion of all required dismantling tasks was officially certified by the Chilean Navy.
scrachall.development.title: Oceanographic Development
scrachall.development.description: Blaue Meer's Ecosocio-Oceanographic Department has specialists in analyzing and identifying oceanographic processes from an ecosystem perspective.
